## Findings

{{narrative:findings}}

Figures in the filed documents that do not agree: a check that does not add up, or a figure that
differs between documents or from an independent reading. Accepted findings are in this report as
filed. Open findings wait for a decision; a held document's figures are not in this report.

{{table:findings}}

## Data coverage

{{narrative:coverage}}

### Mapped figures

How many of the figures read from each statement are mapped to a standard account. Unmapped figures
(or mappings waiting for review) are left out of every metric. Figures read by Claude or by the Docling
PDF add-on from pages fin could not read count as unverified until an independent reading agrees
(`fin verify`).

{{table:coverage}}

### Pages not read

Statement pages fin could not read in the loaded documents.
